text:
maria: FYI I'm seeing a weird divergence between console p99 and the backend telemetry for /v1/generate. Console p99 ~1.2s for the last hour, backend ingest shows ~420ms. Anyone else seeing this?
jon: I saw something similar earlier. Could be sampling differences at the gateway vs our collector. Did you compare sample counts? :thinking:
maria: yes — console shows sample_count=730, backend export shows sample_count=720. counts are close, but percentiles don't line up.
ash: are we sure the console p99 is computed on request end-to-end time? There's some path where edge adds extra tail latency (TLS handshake/ALB spikes) that backend doesn't measure.
lena: to add — the console merges routes with different fallbacks. If /v1/generate falls back to slow model variant under quota, the UI percentile might include fallback requests that backend aggregated separately under "variant=slow" but our UI rollup hides the variant tag by default.
pete: good call. Can you dump a short query with grouping by variant + origin? I can run a quick diff.
maria: pasted quick query I used:```sql
SELECT p50,p95,p99, count() FROM latency WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND window='1h' GROUP BY variant, origin
```
maria: results: origin=edge variant=fast p99=390ms count=520; origin=edge variant=slow p99=1.15s count=60; origin=backend variant=fast p99=410ms count=130. UI rollup: p99=1.2s (it looks like UI is taking global p99 after merging origin/variant).
jon: looks like a classic aggregation semantics problem: UI shows percentile of the merged population rather than a weighted merge of percentiles. That makes sense — heavy tail from small slow variant pumps overall p99.
nash: agreed. Two problems: 1) console UX implies a single runtime measurement but we actually have origin/variant splits; 2) routing/quota fallbacks can introduce tiny counts with large latencies that dominate p99 but users expect stable p95/median.
lena: proposal: add an "attribution" toggle in the latency pane that shows either "merged p99" (current) or "origin-weighted p99" where we compute percentiles from raw samples after applying the selected filters. Also surface a tiny badge "dominant cohort: variant=slow (8%)".
pete: Implementation note: to compute origin-weighted p99 we need raw sample access or maintain TDigest per (origin,variant) and merge them deterministically. We already store tdigest per rollup key but merging many tdigest at query time might be expensive for dashboard queries.
jon: we could lazily compute and cache merged tdigest when a user requests the toggle — cache for like 5m. tracers: @metrics-bot how long does a tdigest merge for ~10 groups take in prod?
metrics-bot: tdigest_merge(10 groups) median latency 85ms, p95 240ms, CPU ~10ms on a query node. Cache hits reduce that to ~6ms.
maria: that seems fine for on-demand UI toggle. For the default view maybe we show both numbers: small glyph p99_merged / p99_weighted so you don't get surprised.
nash: also add hint text: "Percentiles are sensitive to small high-latency cohorts (e.g., fallback routes). Click attribution to see cohort breakdown." Keep the root default simple.
lena: UX microcopy: "Merged p99 (includes fallbacks) vs Cohort-weighted p99 (reconstructs from raw samples)". Also surface sample counts per cohort and percent.
pete: alerting implications — many customers alert on p99. If we change default semantics we'll break alerts. So default must stay current merged but make it obvious and optionally switch.
jon: agree on backward-compat. We should add a prominent tooltip on the alert creation flow: "This p99 uses merged population across variants and origins. To alert on specific cohorts, select attribution filters."
maria: action items: 1) eng-platform — add toggle + badge + cohort table in console (PR: UI). 2) eng-runtime/metrics — expose tdigest merge endpoint and document cost. 3) docs/devex — update alerting docs and add guidance.
nash: I can take the runtime side — I'll prototype a /api/tdigest/merge?keys=... endpoint that returns merged digest + sample_count. ETA 3 days.
lena: I'll mock UI and copy for tooltip, ETA 4 days.
jon: I'll update alerting docs and notify SREs. ETA 2 days.
pete: I'll add a small perf test for tdigest merge at scale.
metrics-bot: note: rolling deploy of metric nodes tomorrow 03:00 UTC — expect ~1m query spikes. Schedule merge endpoint rollout after. :eyes:
maria: thanks everyone. One last ask — can we add a console quick filter for "show only origin=backend" so we can quickly verify backend-only percentiles? small UX but helpful.
lena: added to the backlog, will include in the mock.
maria: ok closing here — I'll open a short RFC summarizing the toggle behavior and the alerting compatibility rules. Thanks! :thumbsup:
